campaign.title: Superior Patios — July 2026 Summer Special
campaign.description: Mid-summer patio promotion featuring 6 free lights on a new patio project.
campaign.html_content:
Book your new patio project and get six free lights included. There is still plenty of outdoor season ahead.
Serving the Inland Empire, Orange County & San Bernardino County (951) 805-0285

The best part of outdoor season
is still ahead.

July heat makes the problem obvious: an uncovered backyard is hard to enjoy. A custom patio cover gives your family a cooler, more comfortable place for late-summer dinners, weekends, and the months beyond.

Built for your home

Custom, not one-size-fits-all

Your cover is designed around your roofline, yard, style, and the way you want to use the space.

Made for the long run

More than a summer upgrade

Enjoy dependable shade now and a more usable outdoor space through fall, winter, and next summer too.

July Summer Special

Get 6 free lights on your new patio project.

Start with a free, no-pressure consultation. We will look at your space, explain your options, and give you a clear quote before you decide.

Request a Free Quote

Prefer to talk first? Call (951) 805-0285

Offer applies to new patio projects. Contact Superior Patios for details.

Licensed. Local. In business since 2014.

Backed by 5-star Google reviews, a lifetime manufacturer's guarantee, and financing available through Lyon Financial. License #998484.

Superior Patios

Custom patio covers, pergolas, gazebos, and retractable awnings.

Phone: (951) 805-0285 | Email: info@superiorpatios.com
